items.title: No killing
items.text: Do not kill.

items.title: No stealing
items.text: Do not take what is not given.

items.title: No sexual misconduct
items.text: Do not engage in sexual misconduct.

items.title: No lying
items.text: Do not lie, not even in jest.

items.title: No alcohol
items.text: Do not drink alcohol, not even a drop.
items.quote: 不得飲酒乃至小草頭一滴

source.title: The Ten Novice Precepts and Deportment
source.canon: Taishō vol. 24, no. 1471; also Zhuhong (蓮池袾宏), 沙彌律儀要略, as quoted in X60 no. 1118

items.title: No killing
items.text: Do not kill.

items.title: No stealing
items.text: Do not steal.

items.title: Celibacy
items.text: Do not engage in any sexual activity.

items.title: No lying
items.text: Do not lie.

items.title: No alcohol
items.text: Do not drink alcohol.

items.title: No garlands or perfume
items.text: Do not wear flower garlands or put scent on the body.

items.title: No shows
items.text: Do not sing, dance or perform, and do not go to watch or listen to performances.

items.title: No high, wide beds
items.text: Do not sit or lie on high, wide, luxurious beds.

items.title: No eating after midday
items.text: Do not eat outside the proper time (from midday until the next dawn).

items.title: No money or valuables
items.text: Do not handle gold, silver, money or other valuables.

source.title_zh: 優婆塞戒經・受戒品第十四
source.title: Upāsakaśīla Sūtra, chapter 14: Receiving the Precepts
source.canon: Taishō vol. 24, no. 1488, tr. Dharmakṣema (曇無讖), c. 426

items.title: No killing
items.text: Do not kill or have anything killed, not even an ant.

items.title: No stealing
items.text: Do not steal, not even a single coin, even to save your life.

items.title: No false claims of attainment
items.text: Do not falsely claim meditative attainments or stages of awakening, even to save your life.
items.quote: 不得虛說我得不淨觀至阿那含

items.title: No sexual misconduct
items.text: Do not engage in sexual misconduct, even to save your life.

items.title: Not broadcasting others' faults
items.text: Do not spread the faults of monks, nuns, laymen or laywomen.
items.quote: 不得宣說比丘比丘尼優婆塞優婆夷所有過罪

items.title: No selling alcohol
items.text: Do not sell alcohol.

items.title: Support parents and teachers
items.text: Support and honour your parents and teachers.

items.title: No indulging in drink
items.text: Do not indulge in drinking alcohol.

items.title: Care for the sick
items.text: Do not turn away in distaste from caring for the sick.

items.title: Give to those who ask
items.text: When someone asks for help, give what you suitably can; do not send them away empty-handed.
items.quote: 不能多少隨宜分與空遣還者

items.title: Greet monastics and elders
items.text: Rise to greet and pay respect to monks, nuns, elders and senior lay practitioners.

items.title: No pride over others' lapses
items.text: When others break their precepts, do not think yourself better than them.

items.title: Keep the eight precepts six days a month
items.text: On six days each month, keep the eight precepts and make offerings to the Three Jewels.
items.quote: 月月之中不能六日受持八戒

items.title: Go to hear the Dharma
items.text: When the Dharma is taught nearby (the text says within forty li), go and listen.
items.quote: 四十里中有講法處不能往聽

items.title: Leave the sangha's furnishings be
items.text: Do not use beds or seats that belong to the whole sangha.

items.title: Spare the creatures in water
items.text: Do not drink water you suspect has living creatures in it.

items.title: Don't travel dangerous places alone
items.text: Do not travel alone through dangerous places.

items.title: Don't stay alone at a nunnery
items.text: Do not spend the night alone at a nunnery.

items.title: Don't beat or abuse workers
items.text: Do not beat or abuse servants, workers or anyone else for the sake of money or a living.
items.quote: 為於財命打罵奴婢僮僕外人

items.title: Don't offer leftovers
items.text: Do not give leftover food to monastics or fellow lay practitioners.

items.title: Don't keep cats
items.text: Do not keep cats.

items.title: Don't keep livestock as your own
items.text: Do not keep livestock for yourself; formally pass them to someone who has not taken the precepts.
items.quote: 一切畜獸不作淨施未受戒者

items.title: Keep robe, bowl and staff
items.text: Keep a monastic robe, a bowl and a staff in store.
items.quote: 若不儲畜僧伽梨衣鉢盂錫杖

items.title: Farm with care for creatures
items.text: If you farm for a living, look for clean water and dry ground.

items.title: Fair prices and honest weights
items.text: In trade, keep to the price you named and use honest weights and measures; if a scale is off, say so.

items.title: Right place and time
items.text: Do not have sex in an improper place or at an improper time.

items.title: Pay your taxes
items.text: In business, pay the taxes you owe; do not dodge them.

items.title: Keep the law
items.text: Do not break the laws of the land.

items.title: Offer first fruits
items.text: When new grain, fruit or vegetables come in, offer some to the Three Jewels before eating them yourself.
items.quote: 若得新穀果苽菜茹不先奉獻供養三寶

items.title: Teach with the sangha's leave
items.text: Do not preach or lead praises unless the sangha has asked you to.
items.quote: 僧若不聽說法讚歎輒自作者

items.title: Don't walk ahead of monastics
items.text: On the road, do not walk in front of monks or novices.
items.quote: 道路若在諸比丘前沙彌前行

items.title: Serve the sangha fairly
items.text: When serving food to the sangha, do not pick out the best for your own teacher or give them more than their share.
items.quote: 偏為師選擇美好過分與之

items.title: Don't raise silkworms
items.text: Do not raise silkworms.

items.title: Don't leave the sick on the road
items.text: If you meet someone sick on the road, stop and help, and see them into someone's care before you go on.
items.quote: 行路之時遇見病者不住瞻視

source.title_zh: 梵網經・盧舍那佛說菩薩心地戒品第十卷下
source.title: Brahmajāla Sūtra, fascicle 2
source.canon: Taishō vol. 24, no. 1484, attributed to Kumārajīva (鳩摩羅什); probably composed in China, 5th century

items.title: No killing
items.text: Do not kill, have others kill, or rejoice in killing; do not deliberately take any life. Protect living beings with compassion.
items.quote: 乃至一切有命者不得故殺

items.title: No stealing
items.text: Do not steal or have others steal, not so much as a needle or a blade of grass. Help others to be well and happy.

items.title: No sexual misconduct
items.text: Do not engage in sexual misconduct (for monastics, any sexual activity) or lead others into it.

items.title: No lying
items.text: Do not lie or have others lie; do not say you saw what you did not, or did not see what you did. Speak truly and help others to.

items.title: No selling alcohol
items.text: Do not sell alcohol or have others sell it; help people toward clarity, not confusion.

items.title: Not broadcasting practitioners' faults
items.text: Do not spread the faults of monastic or lay bodhisattvas, monks or nuns, or have others spread them.
items.quote: 自說出家在家菩薩比丘比丘尼罪過

items.title: No praising yourself and running others down
items.text: Do not praise yourself and disparage others. Take the blame on yourself and give the credit to others.

items.title: No stinginess
items.text: Do not be stingy, with things or with the Dharma, toward those who ask, and do not abuse them.

items.title: No anger that refuses an apology
items.text: Do not give way to anger, abuse or violence; when someone apologizes, let it go.
items.quote: 前人求悔善言懺謝猶瞋不解者

items.title: Not slandering the Three Jewels
items.text: Do not slander the Buddha, the Dharma or the Sangha, or help others to.

items.title: Respect teachers and seniors
items.text: Respect your teachers, seniors and fellow practitioners: rise to greet them, and look after them properly.

items.title: No alcohol
items.text: Do not drink alcohol, or give it to others to drink.

items.title: No meat
items.text: Do not eat meat of any kind.

items.title: No pungent plants
items.text: Do not eat the five pungent plants: garlic, and four kinds of onion, leek and asafoetida.

items.title: Encourage making amends
items.text: When someone breaks their precepts, encourage them to repent and make amends; do not carry on as if nothing happened.

items.title: Welcome Dharma teachers
items.text: Welcome visiting Dharma teachers, provide for them, and ask them to teach.

items.title: Go to hear the Dharma
items.text: Wherever the teachings are being explained, go and listen.

items.title: Don't turn from the Mahāyāna
items.text: Do not turn your back on the Mahāyāna or say it is not the Buddha's teaching.

items.title: Care for the sick
items.text: Care for the sick as you would for a Buddha. Of all the ways of doing good, caring for the sick comes first.

items.title: No weapons
items.text: Do not keep weapons or tools for killing. Do not retaliate, even against someone who has killed your parents.

items.title: No part in war
items.text: Do not, for gain, act as an envoy between armies or help start a war.

items.title: No trading in people, animals or coffins
items.text: Do not trade in people, servants or livestock, or in coffins and burial goods, nor have others do it.

items.title: No slander
items.text: Do not, out of ill will, falsely accuse good people of grave offences.

items.title: No setting fires
items.text: Do not set fires that burn forests and open country, or anyone's home, fields or property.

items.title: Teach the Mahāyāna faithfully
items.text: Teach everyone, Buddhist or not, the Mahāyāna and its meaning; do not, out of ill will, steer them elsewhere.
items.quote: 應一一教受持大乘經律

items.title: Teach honestly, not for gain
items.text: Explain the teachings fully and in order to those who ask; do not, for gain, withhold answers or garble the texts.
items.quote: 倒說經律文字無前無後

items.title: No using the powerful to extort
items.text: Do not court the powerful for food, money or fame, or use their influence to take from others.

items.title: Don't pretend to understand
items.text: Do not claim to understand the precepts when you don't, or confer them on others without understanding them.

items.title: No divisive talk
items.text: Do not, out of ill will, stir up quarrels or slander people of good conduct.

items.title: Release and protect life
items.text: Out of kindness, release and protect living beings; when you see an animal about to be killed, try to save it.

items.title: No revenge
items.text: Do not answer anger with anger or blows with blows; do not take revenge, even for the killing of family.
items.quote: 不得以瞋報瞋以打報打

items.title: Learn from any able teacher
items.text: Do not let pride in your intelligence, rank, age, family or wealth stop you learning from a teacher who is young, poor, low-born or disabled but truly knows the teachings.

items.title: Answer newcomers kindly
items.text: If you know the teachings, answer newcomers' questions carefully, without contempt or condescension.
items.quote: 輕心惡心慢心不一一好答問者

items.title: Study the Mahāyāna first
items.text: Do not neglect the Mahāyāna to study other doctrines and worldly books instead.
items.quote: 反學邪見二乘外道俗典

items.title: Lead a community well
items.text: If you lead a community, keep the peace, settle disputes, and do not spend its property as if it were your own.
items.quote: 善守三寶物莫無度用如自己有

items.title: Share with visiting monastics
items.text: Resident monastics should welcome and provide for visiting ones, and share invitations with them in turn.
items.quote: 先住僧獨受請不差客僧

items.title: No private invitations
items.text: Monastics should not accept offerings by private invitation for themselves; such offerings belong to the whole sangha.
items.quote: 一切不得受別請利養入己

items.title: Invite monastics in turn
items.text: When inviting monastics, ask the monastery to send them in turn; do not pick out particular ones.

items.title: No harmful livelihoods
items.text: Do not, out of ill will or for gain, deal in sex, tell fortunes, practise sorcery, train hawks or make poisons.

items.title: No hypocrisy; keep the fast days
items.text: Do not feign devotion while slandering the Three Jewels, or arrange sexual liaisons for others; do not kill, steal or break precepts on the fasting days and in the fasting months.
items.quote: 於六齋日年三長齋月作殺生劫盜破齋犯戒者

items.title: Ransom images, texts and people
items.text: When images, scriptures, monastics or practitioners are being sold or enslaved, do what you can to buy them free.

items.title: No harming or cheating
items.text: Do not keep weapons, use false weights and measures, take property through official influence, ruin others' work, or raise cats, wildcats, pigs or dogs.
items.quote: 不得畜刀仗弓箭販賣輕秤小斗

items.title: No idle spectacles, games or divination
items.text: Do not, with ill intent, watch fights or battles; do not listen to music for entertainment, gamble, play board games, tell fortunes, or run errands for thieves.
items.quote: 以惡心故觀一切男女等鬪

items.title: Keep the bodhisattva aim
items.text: Keep the precepts day and night as if your life depended on them, and never trade the bodhisattva aim for a lesser one.
items.quote: 若起一念二乘外道心者

items.title: Make the great vows
items.text: Always make vows: to honour parents, teachers and the Three Jewels, to find good teachers and friends, to understand the teachings, and to keep the precepts whatever it costs.
items.quote: 若一切菩薩不發是願者

items.title: Vow never to break the precepts
items.text: Vow that you would rather suffer anything than break the precepts and then live on others' generosity; and vow that all beings may become Buddhas.
items.quote: 寧以此身投熾然猛火大坑刀山終不毀犯三世諸佛經律

items.title: Practise in season; avoid danger
items.text: Keep the seasons of austere practice and retreat, recite the precepts each fortnight, and do not go into dangerous places while practising or travelling.

items.title: Sit by seniority in the precepts
items.text: Sit in order of when you took the precepts, not by age, rank or status.

items.title: Build places of practice and teach
items.text: Help build places of practice, and teach and recite the Mahāyāna for others, especially in sickness, danger and bereavement.
items.quote: 應為一切眾生講說大乘經律

items.title: Confer precepts on anyone
items.text: Give the precepts to anyone who sincerely asks, whatever their status; turn away only those who have committed the gravest crimes.

items.title: Don't teach precepts for gain
items.text: Do not take on disciples or confer precepts for gain or fame while pretending to understand what you do not.
items.quote: 應教請二師和上阿闍梨

items.title: Don't recite the precepts to the hostile
items.text: Do not, for gain, recite these precepts before those who have not taken them or who hold them in contempt.
items.quote: 不得為利養故於未受菩薩戒者前

items.title: Don't break the precepts deliberately
items.text: Having taken the precepts in faith, do not deliberately break them and still accept others' support.

items.title: Honour the scriptures
items.text: Keep, read and copy the Mahāyāna texts, and look after them with honour.
items.quote: 常應一心受持讀誦大乘經律

items.title: Encourage everyone toward awakening
items.text: With great compassion, wherever you go, encourage every being, even animals, to turn toward awakening.
items.quote: 是菩薩若不教化眾生者

items.title: Teach the Dharma with dignity
items.text: When teaching, sit in a proper teaching seat with the listeners seated below; do not stand to preach to lay audiences.

items.title: No laws that suppress the Dharma
items.text: Do not use rank or power to make rules that stop people ordaining, forbid images, stupas and scriptures, or put monastics under state registration and control.

items.title: Don't harm the Dharma from within
items.text: Do not, for fame or gain, bring accusations against monastics before the authorities; protect the precepts like an only child.
